sources.title: cshin23/comp-self-addition-seeds · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Seed checkpoints for the RSI Bench task comp-self (compositional self-improvement). Each is a 14.2M-parameter character-level Llama-style Transformer with no positional encoding (recipe arithmetic_self_improve_v1), trained from scratch on addition (Q: a + b = ?\nA:, answer most-significant digit first), 50,000 examples per length.

sources.snippet: Local Artificial Intelligence Models for Bash Automation If you could ask your terminal "draft a safe Bash script to batch-rename photos by EXIF date" and get a runnable, reviewed script in seconds—would you? Local AI models now make this a reality without sending your command history, logs, or secrets to the cloud. In this guide, you'll learn why local AI belongs in your Bash toolbox ...

sources.title: Bash scripts for self-learning AI algorithms - Linux Bash
sources.snippet: The article explains how Bash, while not performing machine learning itself, excels at orchestrating self-learning AI workflows: automating data fetch and preprocessing, scheduling retraining with cron, managing environments, and piping data between tools.
